title: Design the experiment: written under headings, each marked on its own points

drive.text: Use an Ames test with a histidine-requiring Salmonella strain such as TA1538, spot compound X on discs with and without liver extract, plate at a known number of colony forming units on histidine-free medium and culture for 24 to 48 hours.
Use the same discs without liver extract, and the TA1535 strain, which carries a substitution mutation, as a comparison.
More revertant colonies on TA1538 than on TA1535, and an increase only when liver extract is present.
